# ===== Colony fleets (slices 2-3 design §§ 4-7) =====
# A colony's goal at each stage (the races-only bar reads the current stage's
# through sr_solar_colonization_goal, space_race_values.txt).
sr_colonization_goal_stage_0 = { value = 300 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 = { value = 450 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 = { value = 525 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 = { value = 600 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 = { value = 700 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 = { value = 800 }
sr_cf_horizon_months = { value = 180 }
sr_cf_no_score = { value = -1000 }

# Per world, country scope:
#   sr_cf_base_goal_<key> its own stage's goal, -25% at the lunar world our Moon Landing
#                        named (LANDING_SITES); sr_cf_target_goal reads it, so the chain
#                        sr_solar_colonization_goal -> sr_cf_target_goal never loops back
#   sr_cf_goal_<key>     its colony's goal: its own stage's under simple and full, the
#                        current stage's under races only (a released world costs that);
#                        -25% at the lunar world our Moon Landing named (LANDING_SITES)
#   sr_cf_cost_<key>     what a fleet leaving now spends: goal x (1 + premium);
#                        sr_launch_never's x goal when it can't leave
#   sr_cf_arrival_<key>  the month a fleet leaving now lands, by THIS's drive
#   sr_cf_score_<key>    the automatic pick: 100 - 10 x stage - transit / 2 - 40 x premium
#                        - 10 a fleet inbound - 60 if one lands first
sr_cf_base_goal_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1
}
sr_cf_goal_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_cf_base_goal_valles_marineris
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes } }
		value = sr_solar_colonization_goal
	}
}
sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_launch_target_cost_mars
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_cf_goal_valles_marineris
}
sr_cf_arrival_valles_marineris = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	add = sr_transit_months_mars
}
sr_cf_score_valles_marineris = {
	value = 90
	subtract = { value = sr_transit_months_mars divide = 2 }
	subtract = { value = sr_launch_target_cost_mars multiply = 40 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris } subtract = { value = global_var:sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris multiply = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_beaten_valles_marineris = yes } subtract = 60 }
	min = -900
}

	add = sr_transit_months_neptune
}
sr_cf_score_proteus = {
	value = 60
	subtract = { value = sr_transit_months_neptune divide = 2 }
	subtract = { value = sr_launch_target_cost_neptune multiply = 40 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_proteus } subtract = { value = global_var:sr_site_inbound_proteus multiply = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_beaten_proteus = yes } subtract = 60 }
	min = -900
}

# The best score among the eligible worlds; sr_cf_no_score when none is.
sr_cf_best_score = {
	value = sr_cf_no_score
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_valles_marineris = yes } min = sr_cf_score_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_olympus_mons = yes } min = sr_cf_score_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_hellas_planitia = yes } min = sr_cf_score_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_utopia_planitia = yes } min = sr_cf_score_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_arcadia_planitia = yes } min = sr_cf_score_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_ceres = yes } min = sr_cf_score_ceres }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_vesta = yes } min = sr_cf_score_vesta }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_psyche = yes } min = sr_cf_score_psyche }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_pallas = yes } min = sr_cf_score_pallas }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_hygiea = yes } min = sr_cf_score_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_io = yes } min = sr_cf_score_io }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_europa = yes } min = sr_cf_score_europa }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_ganymede = yes } min = sr_cf_score_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_callisto = yes } min = sr_cf_score_callisto }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_himalia = yes } min = sr_cf_score_himalia }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_amalthea = yes } min = sr_cf_score_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_venus = yes } min = sr_cf_score_venus }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_mercury = yes } min = sr_cf_score_mercury }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_titan = yes } min = sr_cf_score_titan }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_enceladus = yes } min = sr_cf_score_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_rhea = yes } min = sr_cf_score_rhea }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_mimas = yes } min = sr_cf_score_mimas }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_iapetus = yes } min = sr_cf_score_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_titania = yes } min = sr_cf_score_titania }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_oberon = yes } min = sr_cf_score_oberon }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_miranda = yes } min = sr_cf_score_miranda }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_ariel = yes } min = sr_cf_score_ariel }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_triton = yes } min = sr_cf_score_triton }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_proteus = yes } min = sr_cf_score_proteus }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_pluto = yes } min = sr_cf_score_pluto }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_eris = yes } min = sr_cf_score_eris }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_makemake = yes } min = sr_cf_score_makemake }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_haumea = yes } min = sr_cf_score_haumea }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_sedna = yes } min = sr_cf_score_sedna }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_shackleton = yes } min = sr_cf_score_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_peary = yes } min = sr_cf_score_peary }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_tranquility = yes } min = sr_cf_score_tranquility }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_marius_hills = yes } min = sr_cf_score_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_daedalus = yes } min = sr_cf_score_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_imbrium = yes } min = sr_cf_score_imbrium }
}

# The target's goal (sr_solar_colonization_goal under simple and full, which
# alone reads it): its world's sr_cf_base_goal_<key>, the landing site's
# discount included. Not sr_cf_goal_<key>, which reads sr_solar_colonization_goal
# under races only: a static cycle, even though the two legs never both run.
sr_cf_target_goal = {
	value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 1 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_valles_marineris }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 2 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_olympus_mons }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 3 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_hellas_planitia }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 4 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_utopia_planitia }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 5 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_arcadia_planitia }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 6 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_ceres }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 7 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_vesta }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 8 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_psyche }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 9 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_pallas }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 10 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_hygiea }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 11 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_io }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 12 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_europa }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 13 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_ganymede }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 14 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_callisto }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 15 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_himalia }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 16 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_amalthea }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 17 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_venus }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 18 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_mercury }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 19 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_titan }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 20 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_enceladus }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 21 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_rhea }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 22 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_mimas }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 23 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_iapetus }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 24 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_titania }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 25 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_oberon }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 26 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_miranda }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 27 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_ariel }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 28 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_triton }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 29 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_proteus }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 30 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_pluto }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 31 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_eris }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 32 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_makemake }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 33 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_haumea }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 34 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_sedna }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 35 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_shackleton }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 36 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_peary }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 37 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_tranquility }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 38 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_marius_hills }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 39 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_daedalus }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 40 } value = sr_cf_base_goal_imbrium }
}

# ===== Population (slices 2-3 design § 10) =====
sr_site_crew_per_level = { value = 5000 }

# Per world, any scope: its base room (people, before Habitats), its room (+50% of
# the base a Habitat level, slice 4 design § 3), its people, its free room, and
# the module levels above the first its people can crew. Country scope:
# THIS's priority weight for it (Closed 0, Low 1, Normal 2, High 4; Normal when
# unset) and its emigration weight, priority x free room, 0 unless THIS holds it.
sr_site_base_room_valles_marineris = { value = 50000 }
sr_site_room_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_valles_marineris
	multiply = 0.5
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_site_base_room_valles_marineris
}
sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_pop_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_free_room_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_room_valles_marineris
	subtract = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	min = 0
}
sr_site_fill_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	divide = sr_site_room_valles_marineris
}
sr_site_crews_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	divide = sr_site_crew_per_level
	floor = yes
}
sr_emig_prio_weight_valles_marineris = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris var:sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris = 0 } value = 0 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris var:sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris = 1 } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris var:sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris = 3 } value = 4 }
}
sr_emig_weight_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_valles_marineris } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris } } value = sr_emig_prio_weight_valles_marineris multiply = sr_site_free_room_valles_marineris }
}

# Country scope: the sum of THIS's emigration weights; the free room of the
# colonies it holds that are open to settlers; its people off Earth.

	value = 0
	add = sr_emig_weight_valles_marineris
	add = sr_emig_weight_olympus_mons
	add = sr_emig_weight_hellas_planitia

# ===== Modules (slice 4 design §§ 2-4, 7-8) =====
sr_mod_spec_budget = { value = 4 }

# Per world, any scope:
#   sr_site_lvl_<a|b>_value_<key>  a specialization's level; the founding choice
#                                  reads 1 until a module raises it, the other 0
#   sr_site_<hab|def|port>_value_<key>  a generic module's level (a lunar world's
#                                  Spaceport a constant 0: it has none)
#   sr_site_levels_<key>          the levels that need crews (Habitats house them)
#   sr_site_extra_levels_<key>    every module level past the founding outpost's
#   sr_site_staffing_<key>        1 with the crews, AGI or under races only; else
#                                  (crews + 1) / levels (design § 4)
#   sr_site_mult_<a|b>_<key>      a specialization's multiplier: level x staffing
#                                  x the charter's share (slice 5 design § 2)
#   sr_site_<spec|generic>_built_<key>  the levels against each cap
# Country scope, counting THIS's queue and every shipment on its way:
#   sr_mod_spec_used_<key>, sr_mod_slots_used_<key>
sr_site_lvl_a_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_valles_marineris }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris global_var:sr_site_spec_valles_marineris = 1 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_lvl_b_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_b_valles_marineris }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris global_var:sr_site_spec_valles_marineris = 2 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_hab_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_hab_valles_marineris }

sr_site_levels_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_port_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_mine_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_yard_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_lab_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_culture_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_resort_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_black_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_train_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_admin_value_valles_marineris
}
sr_site_extra_levels_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_levels_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_hab_value_valles_marineris
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_levels_valles_marineris
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_valles_marineris = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_valles_marineris < sr_site_crew_needed_valles_marineris
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_valles_marineris
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_valles_marineris
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_valles_marineris
}
sr_site_mult_b_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_valles_marineris
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_valles_marineris } multiply = 0 }
}

# Valles Marineris's slots: 4 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_valles_marineris = {
	value = 4
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_slots_valles_marineris add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_valles_marineris
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_valles_marineris }

}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_valles_marineris >= sr_site_slots_valles_marineris } value = sr_site_generic_pending_valles_marineris subtract = sr_site_slots_valles_marineris add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

# The next module THIS queues at Valles Marineris costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_valles_marineris >= sr_site_slots_valles_marineris } value = sr_mod_slots_used_valles_marineris subtract = sr_site_slots_valles_marineris add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_lvl_a_value_olympus_mons = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_olympus_mons } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_olympus_mons }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_olympus_mons global_var:sr_site_spec_olympus_mons = 1 } value = 1 }
}

sr_site_levels_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_def_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_port_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_mine_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_yard_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_lab_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_culture_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_resort_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_black_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_train_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_admin_value_olympus_mons
}
sr_site_extra_levels_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_levels_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_hab_value_olympus_mons
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_levels_olympus_mons
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_olympus_mons < sr_site_crew_needed_olympus_mons
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_olympus_mons
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_olympus_mons
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_olympus_mons
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_olympus_mons
}
sr_site_mult_b_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_olympus_mons
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_olympus_mons
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_olympus_mons } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_spec_built_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_olympus_mons add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_olympus_mons }
sr_site_generic_built_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_def_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_port_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_mine_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_yard_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_lab_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_culture_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_resort_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_black_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_train_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_admin_value_olympus_mons
}
# Olympus Mons's slots: 3 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_olympus_mons = {
	value = 3
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_slots_olympus_mons add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_olympus_mons
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_olympus_mons }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_olympus_mons >= sr_site_slots_olympus_mons } value = sr_site_generic_pending_olympus_mons subtract = sr_site_slots_olympus_mons add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_mine_value_olympus_mons multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons }
sr_site_yard_staffed_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_yard_value_olympus_mons multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons }
sr_site_lab_staffed_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_lab_value_olympus_mons multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons }
sr_site_culture_staffed_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_culture_value_olympus_mons multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons }
sr_site_resort_staffed_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_resort_value_olympus_mons multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons }
sr_site_black_staffed_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_black_value_olympus_mons multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons }
sr_site_train_staffed_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_train_value_olympus_mons multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons }
sr_site_bunker_staffed_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_bunker_value_olympus_mons multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons }
sr_site_foundry_staffed_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_foundry_value_olympus_mons multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons }
sr_site_admin_staffed_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_admin_value_olympus_mons multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).
sr_site_ebase_room_olympus_mons = {
	value = 30
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_olympus_mons multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }
}
sr_mod_spec_used_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_spec_built_olympus_mons
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_a_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_b_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_olympus_mons }
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_yard_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_yard_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_lab_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_lab_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_culture_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_culture_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_resort_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_resort_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_black_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_black_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_train_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_train_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_bunker_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_bunker_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_foundry_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_foundry_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_admin_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_admin_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_olympus_mons }
}
# The next module THIS queues at Olympus Mons costs this (design § 5): past its slots,

# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_hellas_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_hellas_planitia
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_hellas_planitia }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_hellas_planitia = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_hellas_planitia >= sr_site_slots_hellas_planitia } value = sr_site_generic_pending_hellas_planitia subtract = sr_site_slots_hellas_planitia add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_hellas_planitia = { value = sr_site_mine_value_hellas_planitia multiply = sr_site_staffing_hellas_planitia }
sr_site_yard_staffed_hellas_planitia = { value = sr_site_yard_value_hellas_planitia multiply = sr_site_staffing_hellas_planitia }
sr_site_lab_staffed_hellas_planitia = { value = sr_site_lab_value_hellas_planitia multiply = sr_site_staffing_hellas_planitia }
sr_site_culture_staffed_hellas_planitia = { value = sr_site_culture_value_hellas_planitia multiply = sr_site_staffing_hellas_planitia }
sr_site_resort_staffed_hellas_planitia = { value = sr_site_resort_value_hellas_planitia multiply = sr_site_staffing_hellas_planitia }
sr_site_black_staffed_hellas_planitia = { value = sr_site_black_value_hellas_planitia multiply = sr_site_staffing_hellas_planitia }
sr_site_train_staffed_hellas_planitia = { value = sr_site_train_value_hellas_planitia multiply = sr_site_staffing_hellas_planitia }
sr_site_bunker_staffed_hellas_planitia = { value = sr_site_bunker_value_hellas_planitia multiply = sr_site_staffing_hellas_planitia }
sr_site_foundry_staffed_hellas_planitia = { value = sr_site_foundry_value_hellas_planitia multiply = sr_site_staffing_hellas_planitia }
sr_site_admin_staffed_hellas_planitia = { value = sr_site_admin_value_hellas_planitia multiply = sr_site_staffing_hellas_planitia }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).
sr_site_ebase_room_hellas_planitia = {
	value = 40
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_hellas_planitia multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }
}
sr_mod_spec_used_hellas_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_spec_built_hellas_planitia
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_a_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_b_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_hellas_planitia }
}
sr_mod_slots_used_hellas_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_hellas_planitia
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_hab_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_hab_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_def_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_def_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_port_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_port_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_mine_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_mine_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_yard_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_yard_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_lab_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_lab_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_culture_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_culture_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_resort_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_resort_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_black_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_black_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_train_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_train_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_bunker_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_bunker_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_foundry_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_foundry_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_admin_hellas_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_admin_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_hellas_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_hellas_planitia }
}
# The next module THIS queues at Hellas Planitia costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_hellas_planitia = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_hellas_planitia >= sr_site_slots_hellas_planitia } value = sr_mod_slots_used_hellas_planitia subtract = sr_site_slots_hellas_planitia add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_lvl_a_value_utopia_planitia = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_utopia_planitia } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_utopia_planitia }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_utopia_planitia global_var:sr_site_spec_utopia_planitia = 1 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_lvl_b_value_utopia_planitia = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_utopia_planitia } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_b_utopia_planitia }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_utopia_planitia global_var:sr_site_spec_utopia_planitia = 2 } value = 1 }
}

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_utopia_planitia } value = global_var:sr_site_hab_utopia_planitia }

sr_site_levels_utopia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_def_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_port_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_mine_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_yard_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_lab_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_culture_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_resort_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_black_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_train_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_admin_value_utopia_planitia
}
sr_site_extra_levels_utopia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_levels_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_hab_value_utopia_planitia
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_utopia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_levels_utopia_planitia
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_utopia_planitia = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_utopia_planitia < sr_site_crew_needed_utopia_planitia
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_utopia_planitia
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_utopia_planitia
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_utopia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_utopia_planitia
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_utopia_planitia
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_utopia_planitia
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_utopia_planitia } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_mult_b_utopia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_utopia_planitia
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_utopia_planitia
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_utopia_planitia
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_utopia_planitia } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_spec_built_utopia_planitia = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_utopia_planitia add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_utopia_planitia }
sr_site_generic_built_utopia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_def_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_port_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_mine_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_yard_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_lab_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_culture_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_resort_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_black_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_train_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_utopia_planitia
	add = sr_site_admin_value_utopia_planitia
}
# Utopia Planitia's slots: 4 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_utopia_planitia = {
	value = 4
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_utopia_planitia = { value = sr_site_slots_utopia_planitia add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_utopia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_utopia_planitia

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_resort_utopia_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_resort_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_utopia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_black_utopia_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_black_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_utopia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_train_utopia_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_train_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_utopia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_bunker_utopia_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_bunker_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_utopia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_foundry_utopia_planitia } add = var:sr_mq_foundry_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_utopia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_utopia_planitia }

	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_utopia_planitia >= sr_site_slots_utopia_planitia } value = sr_mod_slots_used_utopia_planitia subtract = sr_site_slots_utopia_planitia add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }

	value = sr_site_levels_arcadia_planitia
	add = sr_site_hab_value_arcadia_planitia
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_arcadia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_levels_arcadia_planitia
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_arcadia_planitia = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_arcadia_planitia < sr_site_crew_needed_arcadia_planitia
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_arcadia_planitia
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_arcadia_planitia
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_arcadia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_arcadia_planitia
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_arcadia_planitia
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_arcadia_planitia
}

# Arcadia Planitia's slots: 3 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_arcadia_planitia = {
	value = 3
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_arcadia_planitia = { value = sr_site_slots_arcadia_planitia add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_arcadia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_arcadia_planitia
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_arcadia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_arcadia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_arcadia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_arcadia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_arcadia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_arcadia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_arcadia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_arcadia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_arcadia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_arcadia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_arcadia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_arcadia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_arcadia_planitia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_arcadia_planitia }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_arcadia_planitia = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_arcadia_planitia >= sr_site_slots_arcadia_planitia } value = sr_site_generic_pending_arcadia_planitia subtract = sr_site_slots_arcadia_planitia add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_ceres < sr_site_crew_needed_ceres
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_ceres
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_ceres
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_ceres = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_ceres
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_ceres
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_ceres
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_ceres } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_mult_b_ceres = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_ceres
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_ceres
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_ceres
}
sr_site_spec_built_ceres = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_ceres add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_ceres }
sr_site_generic_built_ceres = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_ceres
	add = sr_site_def_value_ceres
	add = sr_site_port_value_ceres
	add = sr_site_mine_value_ceres
	add = sr_site_yard_value_ceres
	add = sr_site_lab_value_ceres
	add = sr_site_culture_value_ceres
	add = sr_site_resort_value_ceres
	add = sr_site_black_value_ceres
	add = sr_site_train_value_ceres
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_ceres
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_ceres
	add = sr_site_admin_value_ceres
}
# Ceres's slots: 3 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_ceres = {
	value = 3
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_ceres = { value = sr_site_slots_ceres add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_ceres = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_ceres
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_ceres } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_ceres } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_ceres } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_ceres } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_ceres } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_ceres } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_ceres } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_ceres } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_ceres } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_ceres } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_ceres } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_ceres } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_ceres } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_ceres }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_ceres = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_ceres >= sr_site_slots_ceres } value = sr_site_generic_pending_ceres subtract = sr_site_slots_ceres add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_ceres = { value = sr_site_mine_value_ceres multiply = sr_site_staffing_ceres }
sr_site_yard_staffed_ceres = { value = sr_site_yard_value_ceres multiply = sr_site_staffing_ceres }
sr_site_lab_staffed_ceres = { value = sr_site_lab_value_ceres multiply = sr_site_staffing_ceres }
sr_site_culture_staffed_ceres = { value = sr_site_culture_value_ceres multiply = sr_site_staffing_ceres }
sr_site_resort_staffed_ceres = { value = sr_site_resort_value_ceres multiply = sr_site_staffing_ceres }

sr_site_train_staffed_ceres = { value = sr_site_train_value_ceres multiply = sr_site_staffing_ceres }
sr_site_bunker_staffed_ceres = { value = sr_site_bunker_value_ceres multiply = sr_site_staffing_ceres }
sr_site_foundry_staffed_ceres = { value = sr_site_foundry_value_ceres multiply = sr_site_staffing_ceres }
sr_site_admin_staffed_ceres = { value = sr_site_admin_value_ceres multiply = sr_site_staffing_ceres }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).
sr_site_ebase_room_ceres = {
	value = 40
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_ceres multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }

	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}

	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_vesta < sr_site_crew_needed_vesta
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_vesta
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_vesta
	}
}

	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_psyche global_var:sr_site_spec_psyche = 1 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_lvl_b_value_psyche = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_psyche } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_b_psyche }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_psyche global_var:sr_site_spec_psyche = 2 } value = 1 }
}

	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_psyche

	add = sr_site_hab_value_psyche
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_psyche = {
	value = sr_site_levels_psyche
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_psyche = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_psyche < sr_site_crew_needed_psyche
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_psyche
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_psyche
	}
}

	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_psyche
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_psyche
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_psyche

# 16 Psyche's slots: 2 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_psyche = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_psyche = { value = sr_site_slots_psyche add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_psyche = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_psyche
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_psyche } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_psyche } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_psyche } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_psyche } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_psyche } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_psyche } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_psyche } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_psyche } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_psyche } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_psyche } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_psyche } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_psyche } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_psyche } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_psyche }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_psyche = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_psyche >= sr_site_slots_psyche } value = sr_site_generic_pending_psyche subtract = sr_site_slots_psyche add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

sr_site_yard_staffed_psyche = { value = sr_site_yard_value_psyche multiply = sr_site_staffing_psyche }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_pallas } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_pallas }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_pallas } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_pallas }

# The next module THIS queues at 2 Pallas costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_pallas = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_pallas >= sr_site_slots_pallas } value = sr_mod_slots_used_pallas subtract = sr_site_slots_pallas add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_hygiea } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_hygiea }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_hygiea global_var:sr_site_spec_hygiea = 1 } value = 1 }

	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_hygiea

	add = sr_site_port_value_hygiea

	add = sr_site_black_value_hygiea
	add = sr_site_train_value_hygiea

	add = sr_site_foundry_value_hygiea
	add = sr_site_admin_value_hygiea

	value = sr_site_levels_hygiea
	add = sr_site_hab_value_hygiea
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_hygiea = {
	value = sr_site_levels_hygiea
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_hygiea = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_hygiea < sr_site_crew_needed_hygiea
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_hygiea
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_hygiea
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_hygiea = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_hygiea
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_hygiea
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_hygiea
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_hygiea } multiply = 0 }
}

# 10 Hygiea's slots: 2 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_hygiea = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_hygiea = { value = sr_site_slots_hygiea add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_hygiea = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_hygiea
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_hygiea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_hygiea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_hygiea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_hygiea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_hygiea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_hygiea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_hygiea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_hygiea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_hygiea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_hygiea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_hygiea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_hygiea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_hygiea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_hygiea }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_hygiea = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_hygiea >= sr_site_slots_hygiea } value = sr_site_generic_pending_hygiea subtract = sr_site_slots_hygiea add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

			sr_site_crews_io < sr_site_crew_needed_io

		value = sr_site_crews_io
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_io
	}

	add = sr_site_culture_value_io

	add = sr_site_black_value_io
	add = sr_site_train_value_io
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_io
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_io
	add = sr_site_admin_value_io
}
# Io's slots: 2 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_io = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_io = { value = sr_site_slots_io add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_io = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_io
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_io }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_io = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_io >= sr_site_slots_io } value = sr_site_generic_pending_io subtract = sr_site_slots_io add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_io = { value = sr_site_mine_value_io multiply = sr_site_staffing_io }
sr_site_yard_staffed_io = { value = sr_site_yard_value_io multiply = sr_site_staffing_io }
sr_site_lab_staffed_io = { value = sr_site_lab_value_io multiply = sr_site_staffing_io }
sr_site_culture_staffed_io = { value = sr_site_culture_value_io multiply = sr_site_staffing_io }
sr_site_resort_staffed_io = { value = sr_site_resort_value_io multiply = sr_site_staffing_io }
sr_site_black_staffed_io = { value = sr_site_black_value_io multiply = sr_site_staffing_io }
sr_site_train_staffed_io = { value = sr_site_train_value_io multiply = sr_site_staffing_io }
sr_site_bunker_staffed_io = { value = sr_site_bunker_value_io multiply = sr_site_staffing_io }
sr_site_foundry_staffed_io = { value = sr_site_foundry_value_io multiply = sr_site_staffing_io }
sr_site_admin_staffed_io = { value = sr_site_admin_value_io multiply = sr_site_staffing_io }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).
sr_site_ebase_room_io = {
	value = 20
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_io multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }
}
sr_mod_spec_used_io = {
	value = sr_site_spec_built_io
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_io } add = var:sr_mq_a_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_io }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_io } add = var:sr_mq_b_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_io } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_io }
}

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_hab_io } add = var:sr_mq_hab_io }

# The next module THIS queues at Io costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_io = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_io >= sr_site_slots_io } value = sr_mod_slots_used_io subtract = sr_site_slots_io add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_europa } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_europa }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_europa global_var:sr_site_spec_europa = 1 } value = 1 }

	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_europa
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_europa
	add = sr_site_def_value_europa
	add = sr_site_port_value_europa
	add = sr_site_mine_value_europa
	add = sr_site_yard_value_europa
	add = sr_site_lab_value_europa
	add = sr_site_culture_value_europa
	add = sr_site_resort_value_europa
	add = sr_site_black_value_europa
	add = sr_site_train_value_europa
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_europa
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_europa
	add = sr_site_admin_value_europa
}
sr_site_extra_levels_europa = {
	value = sr_site_levels_europa
	add = sr_site_hab_value_europa
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_europa = {
	value = sr_site_levels_europa
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_europa = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_europa < sr_site_crew_needed_europa
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_europa
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_europa
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_europa = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_europa
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_europa
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_europa
}

	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_europa
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_europa
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_europa

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_mine_ganymede } value = global_var:sr_site_mine_ganymede }
}
sr_site_yard_value_ganymede = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_yard_ganymede } value = global_var:sr_site_yard_ganymede }

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_admin_ganymede } value = global_var:sr_site_admin_ganymede }
}
sr_site_levels_ganymede = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_def_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_port_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_mine_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_yard_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_lab_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_culture_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_resort_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_black_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_train_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_admin_value_ganymede
}
sr_site_extra_levels_ganymede = {
	value = sr_site_levels_ganymede
	add = sr_site_hab_value_ganymede
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_ganymede = {
	value = sr_site_levels_ganymede
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_ganymede = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_ganymede < sr_site_crew_needed_ganymede
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_ganymede
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_ganymede
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_ganymede = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_ganymede
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_ganymede
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_ganymede
}
sr_site_mult_b_ganymede = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_ganymede
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_ganymede
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_ganymede
}
sr_site_spec_built_ganymede = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_ganymede add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_ganymede }
sr_site_generic_built_ganymede = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_def_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_port_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_mine_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_yard_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_lab_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_culture_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_resort_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_black_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_train_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_ganymede
	add = sr_site_admin_value_ganymede
}
# Ganymede's slots: 3 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_ganymede = {
	value = 3
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_ganymede = { value = sr_site_slots_ganymede add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_ganymede = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_ganymede
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_ganymede }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_ganymede = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_ganymede >= sr_site_slots_ganymede } value = sr_site_generic_pending_ganymede subtract = sr_site_slots_ganymede add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_ganymede = { value = sr_site_mine_value_ganymede multiply = sr_site_staffing_ganymede }
sr_site_yard_staffed_ganymede = { value = sr_site_yard_value_ganymede multiply = sr_site_staffing_ganymede }
sr_site_lab_staffed_ganymede = { value = sr_site_lab_value_ganymede multiply = sr_site_staffing_ganymede }
sr_site_culture_staffed_ganymede = { value = sr_site_culture_value_ganymede multiply = sr_site_staffing_ganymede }
sr_site_resort_staffed_ganymede = { value = sr_site_resort_value_ganymede multiply = sr_site_staffing_ganymede }
sr_site_black_staffed_ganymede = { value = sr_site_black_value_ganymede multiply = sr_site_staffing_ganymede }
sr_site_train_staffed_ganymede = { value = sr_site_train_value_ganymede multiply = sr_site_staffing_ganymede }
sr_site_bunker_staffed_ganymede = { value = sr_site_bunker_value_ganymede multiply = sr_site_staffing_ganymede }
sr_site_foundry_staffed_ganymede = { value = sr_site_foundry_value_ganymede multiply = sr_site_staffing_ganymede }
sr_site_admin_staffed_ganymede = { value = sr_site_admin_value_ganymede multiply = sr_site_staffing_ganymede }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).
sr_site_ebase_room_ganymede = {
	value = 30
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_ganymede multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }
}
sr_mod_spec_used_ganymede = {
	value = sr_site_spec_built_ganymede
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_a_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_b_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_ganymede }
}
sr_mod_slots_used_ganymede = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_ganymede
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_hab_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_hab_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_def_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_def_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_port_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_port_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_mine_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_mine_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_yard_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_yard_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_lab_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_lab_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_culture_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_culture_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_resort_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_resort_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_black_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_black_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_train_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_train_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_bunker_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_bunker_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_foundry_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_foundry_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_admin_ganymede } add = var:sr_mq_admin_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_ganymede } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_ganymede }
}
# The next module THIS queues at Ganymede costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_ganymede = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_ganymede >= sr_site_slots_ganymede } value = sr_mod_slots_used_ganymede subtract = sr_site_slots_ganymede add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_lvl_a_value_callisto = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_callisto } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_callisto }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_callisto global_var:sr_site_spec_callisto = 1 } value = 1 }
}

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_callisto } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_b_callisto }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_callisto global_var:sr_site_spec_callisto = 2 } value = 1 }
}

	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_callisto

	value = sr_site_levels_callisto
	add = sr_site_hab_value_callisto
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_callisto = {
	value = sr_site_levels_callisto
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_callisto = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_callisto < sr_site_crew_needed_callisto
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_callisto
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_callisto
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_callisto = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_callisto
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_callisto
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_callisto
}

	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_callisto
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_callisto
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_callisto

	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_callisto }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_callisto }

# sr_module_points x (1 + n).

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_hab_callisto } add = var:sr_mq_hab_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_def_callisto } add = var:sr_mq_def_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_port_callisto } add = var:sr_mq_port_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_mine_callisto } add = var:sr_mq_mine_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_yard_callisto } add = var:sr_mq_yard_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_lab_callisto } add = var:sr_mq_lab_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_culture_callisto } add = var:sr_mq_culture_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_resort_callisto } add = var:sr_mq_resort_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_black_callisto } add = var:sr_mq_black_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_train_callisto } add = var:sr_mq_train_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_callisto }
