	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_admin_callisto } add = var:sr_mq_admin_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_callisto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_callisto }
}
# The next module THIS queues at Callisto costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_callisto = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_callisto >= sr_site_slots_callisto } value = sr_mod_slots_used_callisto subtract = sr_site_slots_callisto add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_lvl_a_value_himalia = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_himalia } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_himalia }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_himalia global_var:sr_site_spec_himalia = 1 } value = 1 }
}

sr_site_levels_himalia = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_def_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_port_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_mine_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_yard_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_lab_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_culture_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_resort_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_black_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_train_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_admin_value_himalia
}
sr_site_extra_levels_himalia = {
	value = sr_site_levels_himalia
	add = sr_site_hab_value_himalia
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_himalia = {
	value = sr_site_levels_himalia
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_himalia = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_himalia < sr_site_crew_needed_himalia
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_himalia
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_himalia
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_himalia = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_himalia
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_himalia
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_himalia
}
sr_site_mult_b_himalia = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_himalia
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_himalia
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_himalia
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_himalia } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_spec_built_himalia = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_himalia add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_himalia }

	add = sr_site_yard_value_himalia

	add = sr_site_bunker_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_himalia
	add = sr_site_admin_value_himalia
}
# Himalia's slots: 1 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_himalia = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_himalia = { value = sr_site_slots_himalia add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_himalia = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_himalia
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_himalia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_himalia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_himalia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_himalia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_himalia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_himalia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_himalia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_himalia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_himalia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_himalia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_himalia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_himalia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_himalia } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_himalia }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_himalia = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_himalia >= sr_site_slots_himalia } value = sr_site_generic_pending_himalia subtract = sr_site_slots_himalia add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

	add = sr_site_lab_value_amalthea
	add = sr_site_culture_value_amalthea
	add = sr_site_resort_value_amalthea
	add = sr_site_black_value_amalthea
	add = sr_site_train_value_amalthea
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_amalthea
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_amalthea
	add = sr_site_admin_value_amalthea
}
# Amalthea's slots: 1 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_amalthea = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_amalthea ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_amalthea ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_amalthea = { value = sr_site_slots_amalthea add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_amalthea = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_amalthea
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_amalthea }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_amalthea = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_amalthea >= sr_site_slots_amalthea } value = sr_site_generic_pending_amalthea subtract = sr_site_slots_amalthea add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_amalthea = { value = sr_site_mine_value_amalthea multiply = sr_site_staffing_amalthea }
sr_site_yard_staffed_amalthea = { value = sr_site_yard_value_amalthea multiply = sr_site_staffing_amalthea }
sr_site_lab_staffed_amalthea = { value = sr_site_lab_value_amalthea multiply = sr_site_staffing_amalthea }

sr_site_foundry_staffed_amalthea = { value = sr_site_foundry_value_amalthea multiply = sr_site_staffing_amalthea }
sr_site_admin_staffed_amalthea = { value = sr_site_admin_value_amalthea multiply = sr_site_staffing_amalthea }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).
sr_site_ebase_room_amalthea = {
	value = 10
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_amalthea multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }
}

	value = sr_site_spec_built_amalthea
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_amalthea } add = var:sr_mq_a_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_amalthea } add = var:sr_mq_b_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_amalthea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_amalthea }
}

# The next module THIS queues at Amalthea costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_amalthea = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_amalthea >= sr_site_slots_amalthea } value = sr_mod_slots_used_amalthea subtract = sr_site_slots_amalthea add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_venus } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_venus }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_venus global_var:sr_site_spec_venus = 1 } value = 1 }

	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_venus
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_venus
	add = sr_site_def_value_venus
	add = sr_site_port_value_venus

	add = sr_site_foundry_value_venus

	value = sr_site_levels_venus
	add = sr_site_hab_value_venus
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_venus = {
	value = sr_site_levels_venus
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_venus = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_venus < sr_site_crew_needed_venus
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_venus
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_venus
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_venus = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_venus
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_venus
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_venus
}
sr_site_mult_b_venus = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_venus
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_venus
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_venus
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_venus } multiply = 0 }
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_mercury } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_b_mercury }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_mercury global_var:sr_site_spec_mercury = 2 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_hab_value_mercury = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_mercury } value = global_var:sr_site_hab_mercury }

}
sr_site_levels_mercury = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_def_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_port_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_mine_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_yard_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_lab_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_culture_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_resort_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_black_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_train_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_admin_value_mercury
}
sr_site_extra_levels_mercury = {
	value = sr_site_levels_mercury
	add = sr_site_hab_value_mercury
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_mercury = {
	value = sr_site_levels_mercury
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_mercury = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_mercury < sr_site_crew_needed_mercury
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_mercury
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_mercury
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_mercury = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_mercury
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_mercury
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_mercury
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_mercury } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_mult_b_mercury = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_mercury
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_mercury
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_mercury
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_mercury } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_spec_built_mercury = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_mercury add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_mercury }
sr_site_generic_built_mercury = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_def_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_port_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_mine_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_yard_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_lab_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_culture_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_resort_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_black_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_train_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_mercury
	add = sr_site_admin_value_mercury
}
# Mercury's slots: 3 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_mercury = {
	value = 3
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_mercury = { value = sr_site_slots_mercury add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_mercury = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_mercury
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_mercury }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_mercury = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_mercury >= sr_site_slots_mercury } value = sr_site_generic_pending_mercury subtract = sr_site_slots_mercury add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_mercury = { value = sr_site_mine_value_mercury multiply = sr_site_staffing_mercury }
sr_site_yard_staffed_mercury = { value = sr_site_yard_value_mercury multiply = sr_site_staffing_mercury }
sr_site_lab_staffed_mercury = { value = sr_site_lab_value_mercury multiply = sr_site_staffing_mercury }
sr_site_culture_staffed_mercury = { value = sr_site_culture_value_mercury multiply = sr_site_staffing_mercury }
sr_site_resort_staffed_mercury = { value = sr_site_resort_value_mercury multiply = sr_site_staffing_mercury }
sr_site_black_staffed_mercury = { value = sr_site_black_value_mercury multiply = sr_site_staffing_mercury }
sr_site_train_staffed_mercury = { value = sr_site_train_value_mercury multiply = sr_site_staffing_mercury }
sr_site_bunker_staffed_mercury = { value = sr_site_bunker_value_mercury multiply = sr_site_staffing_mercury }
sr_site_foundry_staffed_mercury = { value = sr_site_foundry_value_mercury multiply = sr_site_staffing_mercury }
sr_site_admin_staffed_mercury = { value = sr_site_admin_value_mercury multiply = sr_site_staffing_mercury }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).
sr_site_ebase_room_mercury = {
	value = 40
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_mercury multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }
}
sr_mod_spec_used_mercury = {
	value = sr_site_spec_built_mercury
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_a_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_b_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_mercury }
}
sr_mod_slots_used_mercury = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_mercury
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_hab_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_hab_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_def_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_def_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_mercury }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_mine_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_mine_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_yard_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_yard_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_lab_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_lab_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_culture_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_culture_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_resort_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_resort_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_black_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_black_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_train_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_train_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_bunker_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_bunker_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_foundry_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_foundry_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_admin_mercury } add = var:sr_mq_admin_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_mercury } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_mercury }
}
# The next module THIS queues at Mercury costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_mercury = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_mercury >= sr_site_slots_mercury } value = sr_mod_slots_used_mercury subtract = sr_site_slots_mercury add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

	value = sr_site_levels_titan
	subtract = 1
	min = 0

sr_site_staffing_titan = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_titan < sr_site_crew_needed_titan
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titan ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_titan
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_titan
	}
}

	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_titan
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_titan
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_titan

sr_site_admin_staffed_titan = { value = sr_site_admin_value_titan multiply = sr_site_staffing_titan }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).
sr_site_ebase_room_titan = {
	value = 20
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_titan multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }
}
sr_mod_spec_used_titan = {
	value = sr_site_spec_built_titan
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_titan } add = var:sr_mq_a_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_titan } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_titan } add = var:sr_mq_b_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_titan } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_titan }
}
sr_mod_slots_used_titan = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_titan
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_hab_titan } add = var:sr_mq_hab_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_titan } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_def_titan } add = var:sr_mq_def_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_titan } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_port_titan } add = var:sr_mq_port_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_titan } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_mine_titan } add = var:sr_mq_mine_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_titan } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_titan }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_titan } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_titan }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_titan } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_culture_titan } add = var:sr_mq_culture_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_titan } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_resort_titan } add = var:sr_mq_resort_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_titan } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_black_titan } add = var:sr_mq_black_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_titan } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_train_titan } add = var:sr_mq_train_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_titan } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_titan }

}
# The next module THIS queues at Titan costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_titan = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_titan >= sr_site_slots_titan } value = sr_mod_slots_used_titan subtract = sr_site_slots_titan add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_enceladus } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_enceladus }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_enceladus global_var:sr_site_spec_enceladus = 1 } value = 1 }

	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_def_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_port_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_mine_value_enceladus

	add = sr_site_culture_value_enceladus

	add = sr_site_black_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_train_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_admin_value_enceladus
}
sr_site_extra_levels_enceladus = {
	value = sr_site_levels_enceladus
	add = sr_site_hab_value_enceladus
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_enceladus = {
	value = sr_site_levels_enceladus
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_enceladus = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_enceladus < sr_site_crew_needed_enceladus
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_enceladus
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_enceladus
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_enceladus = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_enceladus
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_enceladus
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_enceladus
}
sr_site_mult_b_enceladus = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_enceladus
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_enceladus
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_enceladus
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_enceladus } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_spec_built_enceladus = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_enceladus add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_enceladus }

	value = sr_site_hab_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_def_value_enceladus

	add = sr_site_mine_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_yard_value_enceladus

	add = sr_site_black_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_train_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_enceladus
	add = sr_site_admin_value_enceladus
}
# Enceladus's slots: 2 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_enceladus = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_enceladus = { value = sr_site_slots_enceladus add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_enceladus = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_enceladus
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_enceladus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_enceladus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_enceladus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_enceladus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_enceladus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_enceladus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_enceladus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_enceladus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_enceladus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_enceladus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_enceladus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_enceladus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_enceladus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_enceladus }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_enceladus = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_enceladus >= sr_site_slots_enceladus } value = sr_site_generic_pending_enceladus subtract = sr_site_slots_enceladus add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

sr_site_crew_needed_rhea = {
	value = sr_site_levels_rhea
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_rhea = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_rhea < sr_site_crew_needed_rhea
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_rhea
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_rhea
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_rhea = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_rhea
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_rhea
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_rhea
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_rhea } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_mult_b_rhea = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_rhea
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_rhea
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_rhea
}
sr_site_spec_built_rhea = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_rhea add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_rhea }
sr_site_generic_built_rhea = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_rhea
	add = sr_site_def_value_rhea
	add = sr_site_port_value_rhea
	add = sr_site_mine_value_rhea
	add = sr_site_yard_value_rhea
	add = sr_site_lab_value_rhea
	add = sr_site_culture_value_rhea
	add = sr_site_resort_value_rhea
	add = sr_site_black_value_rhea
	add = sr_site_train_value_rhea
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_rhea
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_rhea
	add = sr_site_admin_value_rhea
}
# Rhea's slots: 2 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_rhea = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_rhea = { value = sr_site_slots_rhea add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_rhea = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_rhea
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_rhea }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_rhea = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_rhea >= sr_site_slots_rhea } value = sr_site_generic_pending_rhea subtract = sr_site_slots_rhea add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_rhea = { value = sr_site_mine_value_rhea multiply = sr_site_staffing_rhea }
sr_site_yard_staffed_rhea = { value = sr_site_yard_value_rhea multiply = sr_site_staffing_rhea }
sr_site_lab_staffed_rhea = { value = sr_site_lab_value_rhea multiply = sr_site_staffing_rhea }
sr_site_culture_staffed_rhea = { value = sr_site_culture_value_rhea multiply = sr_site_staffing_rhea }
sr_site_resort_staffed_rhea = { value = sr_site_resort_value_rhea multiply = sr_site_staffing_rhea }
sr_site_black_staffed_rhea = { value = sr_site_black_value_rhea multiply = sr_site_staffing_rhea }
sr_site_train_staffed_rhea = { value = sr_site_train_value_rhea multiply = sr_site_staffing_rhea }
sr_site_bunker_staffed_rhea = { value = sr_site_bunker_value_rhea multiply = sr_site_staffing_rhea }
sr_site_foundry_staffed_rhea = { value = sr_site_foundry_value_rhea multiply = sr_site_staffing_rhea }
sr_site_admin_staffed_rhea = { value = sr_site_admin_value_rhea multiply = sr_site_staffing_rhea }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).
sr_site_ebase_room_rhea = {
	value = 20
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_rhea multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }
}

	value = sr_site_spec_built_rhea
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_rhea } add = var:sr_mq_a_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_rhea } add = var:sr_mq_b_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_rhea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_rhea }
}

	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_rhea >= sr_site_slots_rhea } value = sr_mod_slots_used_rhea subtract = sr_site_slots_rhea add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }

	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_mimas global_var:sr_site_spec_mimas = 1 } value = 1 }

sr_site_lvl_a_value_iapetus = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_iapetus } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_iapetus }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_iapetus global_var:sr_site_spec_iapetus = 1 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_lvl_b_value_iapetus = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_iapetus } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_b_iapetus }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_iapetus global_var:sr_site_spec_iapetus = 2 } value = 1 }
}

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_iapetus } value = global_var:sr_site_hab_iapetus }

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_admin_iapetus } value = global_var:sr_site_admin_iapetus }
}
sr_site_levels_iapetus = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_def_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_port_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_mine_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_yard_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_lab_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_culture_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_resort_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_black_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_train_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_admin_value_iapetus
}
sr_site_extra_levels_iapetus = {
	value = sr_site_levels_iapetus
	add = sr_site_hab_value_iapetus
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_iapetus = {
	value = sr_site_levels_iapetus
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_iapetus = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_iapetus < sr_site_crew_needed_iapetus
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_iapetus
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_iapetus
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_iapetus = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_iapetus
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_iapetus
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_iapetus
}
sr_site_mult_b_iapetus = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_iapetus
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_iapetus
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_iapetus
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_iapetus } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_spec_built_iapetus = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_iapetus add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_iapetus }
sr_site_generic_built_iapetus = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_def_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_port_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_mine_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_yard_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_lab_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_culture_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_resort_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_black_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_train_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_iapetus
	add = sr_site_admin_value_iapetus
}
# Iapetus's slots: 2 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_iapetus = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_iapetus = { value = sr_site_slots_iapetus add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_iapetus = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_iapetus
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_iapetus }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_iapetus = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_iapetus >= sr_site_slots_iapetus } value = sr_site_generic_pending_iapetus subtract = sr_site_slots_iapetus add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_iapetus = { value = sr_site_mine_value_iapetus multiply = sr_site_staffing_iapetus }
sr_site_yard_staffed_iapetus = { value = sr_site_yard_value_iapetus multiply = sr_site_staffing_iapetus }
sr_site_lab_staffed_iapetus = { value = sr_site_lab_value_iapetus multiply = sr_site_staffing_iapetus }
sr_site_culture_staffed_iapetus = { value = sr_site_culture_value_iapetus multiply = sr_site_staffing_iapetus }
sr_site_resort_staffed_iapetus = { value = sr_site_resort_value_iapetus multiply = sr_site_staffing_iapetus }
sr_site_black_staffed_iapetus = { value = sr_site_black_value_iapetus multiply = sr_site_staffing_iapetus }
sr_site_train_staffed_iapetus = { value = sr_site_train_value_iapetus multiply = sr_site_staffing_iapetus }
sr_site_bunker_staffed_iapetus = { value = sr_site_bunker_value_iapetus multiply = sr_site_staffing_iapetus }
sr_site_foundry_staffed_iapetus = { value = sr_site_foundry_value_iapetus multiply = sr_site_staffing_iapetus }
sr_site_admin_staffed_iapetus = { value = sr_site_admin_value_iapetus multiply = sr_site_staffing_iapetus }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).
sr_site_ebase_room_iapetus = {
	value = 15
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_iapetus multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }
}
sr_mod_spec_used_iapetus = {
	value = sr_site_spec_built_iapetus
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_iapetus } add = var:sr_mq_a_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_iapetus } add = var:sr_mq_b_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_iapetus }
}

	value = sr_site_generic_built_iapetus
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_hab_iapetus } add = var:sr_mq_hab_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_iapetus }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_mine_iapetus } add = var:sr_mq_mine_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_yard_iapetus } add = var:sr_mq_yard_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_lab_iapetus } add = var:sr_mq_lab_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_culture_iapetus } add = var:sr_mq_culture_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_resort_iapetus } add = var:sr_mq_resort_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_black_iapetus } add = var:sr_mq_black_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_train_iapetus } add = var:sr_mq_train_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_bunker_iapetus } add = var:sr_mq_bunker_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_foundry_iapetus } add = var:sr_mq_foundry_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_admin_iapetus } add = var:sr_mq_admin_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_iapetus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_iapetus }
}
# The next module THIS queues at Iapetus costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_iapetus = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_iapetus >= sr_site_slots_iapetus } value = sr_mod_slots_used_iapetus subtract = sr_site_slots_iapetus add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

	value = sr_site_levels_titania
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_titania = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_titania < sr_site_crew_needed_titania
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_titania
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_titania
	}
}

	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_titania
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_titania
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_titania
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_titania } multiply = 0 }
}

# Titania's slots: 2 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.

	value = 2
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_titania = { value = sr_site_slots_titania add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_titania = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_titania

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_titania }

# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_titania = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_titania >= sr_site_slots_titania } value = sr_site_generic_pending_titania subtract = sr_site_slots_titania add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_titania = { value = sr_site_mine_value_titania multiply = sr_site_staffing_titania }

# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).

	value = 15
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_titania multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }

	value = sr_site_spec_built_titania
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_titania } add = var:sr_mq_a_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_titania }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_titania } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_titania }

# The next module THIS queues at Titania costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_titania = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_titania >= sr_site_slots_titania } value = sr_mod_slots_used_titania subtract = sr_site_slots_titania add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_lvl_a_value_oberon = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_oberon } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_oberon }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_oberon global_var:sr_site_spec_oberon = 1 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_lvl_b_value_oberon = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_oberon } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_b_oberon }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_oberon global_var:sr_site_spec_oberon = 2 } value = 1 }
}

sr_site_levels_oberon = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_def_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_port_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_mine_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_yard_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_lab_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_culture_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_resort_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_black_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_train_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_admin_value_oberon
}
sr_site_extra_levels_oberon = {
	value = sr_site_levels_oberon
	add = sr_site_hab_value_oberon
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_oberon = {
	value = sr_site_levels_oberon
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_oberon = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_oberon < sr_site_crew_needed_oberon
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_oberon
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_oberon
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_oberon = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_oberon
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_oberon
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_oberon
}
sr_site_mult_b_oberon = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_oberon
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_oberon
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_oberon
}
sr_site_spec_built_oberon = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_oberon add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_oberon }

	value = sr_site_hab_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_def_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_port_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_mine_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_yard_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_lab_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_culture_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_resort_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_black_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_train_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_oberon
	add = sr_site_admin_value_oberon
}
# Oberon's slots: 2 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_oberon = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_oberon = { value = sr_site_slots_oberon add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_oberon = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_oberon
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_oberon } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_oberon }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_oberon } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_oberon }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_oberon } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_oberon }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_oberon } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_oberon }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_oberon } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_oberon }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_oberon } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_oberon }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_oberon } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_oberon }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_oberon } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_oberon }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_oberon } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_oberon }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_oberon } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_oberon }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_oberon } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_oberon }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_oberon } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_oberon }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_oberon } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_oberon }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_oberon = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_oberon >= sr_site_slots_oberon } value = sr_site_generic_pending_oberon subtract = sr_site_slots_oberon add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

# Miranda's slots: 1 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_miranda = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_miranda = { value = sr_site_slots_miranda add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_miranda = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_miranda
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_miranda } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_miranda } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_miranda } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_miranda } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_miranda } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_miranda } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_miranda } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_miranda } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_miranda } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_miranda } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_miranda } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_miranda } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_miranda } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_miranda }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_miranda = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_miranda >= sr_site_slots_miranda } value = sr_site_generic_pending_miranda subtract = sr_site_slots_miranda add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

	subtract = 1
	min = 0

	value = sr_site_levels_ariel
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_ariel = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_ariel < sr_site_crew_needed_ariel
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_ariel
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_ariel
	}
}

	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_ariel
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_ariel
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_ariel

sr_site_levels_triton = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_triton
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_triton
	add = sr_site_def_value_triton
	add = sr_site_port_value_triton
	add = sr_site_mine_value_triton
	add = sr_site_yard_value_triton
	add = sr_site_lab_value_triton
	add = sr_site_culture_value_triton
	add = sr_site_resort_value_triton
	add = sr_site_black_value_triton
	add = sr_site_train_value_triton
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_triton
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_triton
	add = sr_site_admin_value_triton
}
sr_site_extra_levels_triton = {
	value = sr_site_levels_triton
	add = sr_site_hab_value_triton
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_triton = {
	value = sr_site_levels_triton
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_triton = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_triton < sr_site_crew_needed_triton
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_triton
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_triton
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_triton = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_triton
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_triton
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_triton
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_triton } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_mult_b_triton = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_triton
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_triton
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_triton
}

	value = sr_site_hab_value_triton
	add = sr_site_def_value_triton

	add = sr_site_yard_value_triton
	add = sr_site_lab_value_triton

	add = sr_site_bunker_value_triton
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_triton
	add = sr_site_admin_value_triton
}
# Triton's slots: 2 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_triton = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_triton = { value = sr_site_slots_triton add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_triton = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_triton
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_triton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_triton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_triton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_triton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_triton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_triton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_triton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_triton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_triton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_triton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_triton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_triton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_triton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_triton }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_triton = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_triton >= sr_site_slots_triton } value = sr_site_generic_pending_triton subtract = sr_site_slots_triton add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_triton = { value = sr_site_mine_value_triton multiply = sr_site_staffing_triton }
sr_site_yard_staffed_triton = { value = sr_site_yard_value_triton multiply = sr_site_staffing_triton }
sr_site_lab_staffed_triton = { value = sr_site_lab_value_triton multiply = sr_site_staffing_triton }
sr_site_culture_staffed_triton = { value = sr_site_culture_value_triton multiply = sr_site_staffing_triton }
sr_site_resort_staffed_triton = { value = sr_site_resort_value_triton multiply = sr_site_staffing_triton }
sr_site_black_staffed_triton = { value = sr_site_black_value_triton multiply = sr_site_staffing_triton }
sr_site_train_staffed_triton = { value = sr_site_train_value_triton multiply = sr_site_staffing_triton }
sr_site_bunker_staffed_triton = { value = sr_site_bunker_value_triton multiply = sr_site_staffing_triton }
sr_site_foundry_staffed_triton = { value = sr_site_foundry_value_triton multiply = sr_site_staffing_triton }
sr_site_admin_staffed_triton = { value = sr_site_admin_value_triton multiply = sr_site_staffing_triton }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).
sr_site_ebase_room_triton = {
	value = 15
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_triton multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }

# The next module THIS queues at Triton costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.

	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_triton >= sr_site_slots_triton } value = sr_mod_slots_used_triton subtract = sr_site_slots_triton add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_proteus
	}

# The next module THIS queues at Proteus costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_proteus = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_proteus >= sr_site_slots_proteus } value = sr_mod_slots_used_proteus subtract = sr_site_slots_proteus add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_pluto } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_pluto }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_pluto global_var:sr_site_spec_pluto = 1 } value = 1 }

	add = sr_site_hab_value_pluto
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}

	value = sr_site_levels_pluto
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_pluto = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_pluto < sr_site_crew_needed_pluto
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_pluto
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_pluto
	}
}

	multiply = sr_site_staffing_pluto
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_pluto

# Pluto-Charon's slots: 2 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_pluto = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_pluto = { value = sr_site_slots_pluto add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_pluto = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_pluto
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_pluto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_pluto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_pluto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_pluto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_pluto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_pluto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_pluto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_pluto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_pluto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_pluto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_pluto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_pluto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_pluto } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_pluto }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_pluto = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_pluto >= sr_site_slots_pluto } value = sr_site_generic_pending_pluto subtract = sr_site_slots_pluto add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_eris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_eris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_eris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_eris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_eris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_eris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_eris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_eris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_eris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_eris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_eris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_eris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_eris }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_eris = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_eris >= sr_site_slots_eris } value = sr_site_generic_pending_eris subtract = sr_site_slots_eris add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

sr_site_yard_staffed_eris = { value = sr_site_yard_value_eris multiply = sr_site_staffing_eris }

	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_eris multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }

	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_makemake
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_makemake
	add = sr_site_def_value_makemake
	add = sr_site_port_value_makemake
	add = sr_site_mine_value_makemake
	add = sr_site_yard_value_makemake
	add = sr_site_lab_value_makemake
	add = sr_site_culture_value_makemake
	add = sr_site_resort_value_makemake
	add = sr_site_black_value_makemake
	add = sr_site_train_value_makemake
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_makemake
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_makemake
	add = sr_site_admin_value_makemake

sr_site_extra_levels_makemake = {
	value = sr_site_levels_makemake
	add = sr_site_hab_value_makemake
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_makemake = {
	value = sr_site_levels_makemake
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_makemake = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_makemake < sr_site_crew_needed_makemake
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_makemake
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_makemake
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_makemake = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_makemake
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_makemake
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_makemake
}

	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_makemake
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_makemake
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_makemake

}
# Makemake's slots: 1 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_makemake = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_makemake = { value = sr_site_slots_makemake add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_makemake = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_makemake

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_makemake }
