	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_culture_haumea } value = global_var:sr_site_culture_haumea }
}
sr_site_resort_value_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_resort_haumea } value = global_var:sr_site_resort_haumea }
}
sr_site_black_value_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_black_haumea } value = global_var:sr_site_black_haumea }
}
sr_site_train_value_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_train_haumea } value = global_var:sr_site_train_haumea }
}
sr_site_bunker_value_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_bunker_haumea } value = global_var:sr_site_bunker_haumea }
}
sr_site_foundry_value_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_foundry_haumea } value = global_var:sr_site_foundry_haumea }
}
sr_site_admin_value_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_admin_haumea } value = global_var:sr_site_admin_haumea }
}
sr_site_levels_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_def_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_port_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_mine_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_yard_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_lab_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_culture_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_resort_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_black_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_train_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_admin_value_haumea
}
sr_site_extra_levels_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_levels_haumea
	add = sr_site_hab_value_haumea
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_levels_haumea
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_haumea = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_haumea < sr_site_crew_needed_haumea
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_haumea
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_haumea
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_haumea
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_haumea
}
sr_site_mult_b_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_haumea
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_haumea
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_haumea } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_spec_built_haumea = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_haumea add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_haumea }
sr_site_generic_built_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_def_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_port_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_mine_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_yard_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_lab_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_culture_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_resort_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_black_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_train_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_admin_value_haumea
}
# Haumea's slots: 1 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_haumea = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_haumea = { value = sr_site_slots_haumea add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_haumea
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_haumea }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_haumea = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_haumea >= sr_site_slots_haumea } value = sr_site_generic_pending_haumea subtract = sr_site_slots_haumea add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_haumea = { value = sr_site_mine_value_haumea multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea }
sr_site_yard_staffed_haumea = { value = sr_site_yard_value_haumea multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea }
sr_site_lab_staffed_haumea = { value = sr_site_lab_value_haumea multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea }
sr_site_culture_staffed_haumea = { value = sr_site_culture_value_haumea multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea }
sr_site_resort_staffed_haumea = { value = sr_site_resort_value_haumea multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea }
sr_site_black_staffed_haumea = { value = sr_site_black_value_haumea multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea }
sr_site_train_staffed_haumea = { value = sr_site_train_value_haumea multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea }
sr_site_bunker_staffed_haumea = { value = sr_site_bunker_value_haumea multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea }
sr_site_foundry_staffed_haumea = { value = sr_site_foundry_value_haumea multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea }
sr_site_admin_staffed_haumea = { value = sr_site_admin_value_haumea multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).
sr_site_ebase_room_haumea = {
	value = 10
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_haumea multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }
}
sr_mod_spec_used_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_spec_built_haumea
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_a_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_b_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_haumea }
}
sr_mod_slots_used_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_haumea
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_hab_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_hab_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_def_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_def_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_port_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_port_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_mine_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_mine_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_yard_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_yard_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_lab_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_lab_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_culture_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_culture_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_resort_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_resort_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_black_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_black_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_train_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_train_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_bunker_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_bunker_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_foundry_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_foundry_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_admin_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_admin_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_haumea } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_haumea }
}
# The next module THIS queues at Haumea costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_haumea = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_haumea >= sr_site_slots_haumea } value = sr_mod_slots_used_haumea subtract = sr_site_slots_haumea add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_lvl_a_value_sedna = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_sedna } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_sedna }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_sedna global_var:sr_site_spec_sedna = 1 } value = 1 }
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_sedna } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_b_sedna }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_sedna global_var:sr_site_spec_sedna = 2 } value = 1 }

	value = sr_site_levels_sedna
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_sedna = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_sedna < sr_site_crew_needed_sedna
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_sedna
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_sedna
	}
}

# The next module THIS queues at Sedna costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_sedna = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_sedna >= sr_site_slots_sedna } value = sr_mod_slots_used_sedna subtract = sr_site_slots_sedna add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_shackleton } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_shackleton }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_shackleton global_var:sr_site_spec_shackleton = 1 } value = 1 }

	add = sr_site_hab_value_shackleton
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_shackleton = {
	value = sr_site_levels_shackleton
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_shackleton = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_shackleton < sr_site_crew_needed_shackleton
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_shackleton ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_shackleton
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_shackleton
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_shackleton = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_shackleton
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_shackleton
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_shackleton
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_shackleton } multiply = 0 }
}

# Shackleton Crater's slots: 2 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_shackleton = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_shackleton ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_shackleton ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_shackleton = { value = sr_site_slots_shackleton add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_shackleton = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_shackleton
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_shackleton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_shackleton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_shackleton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_shackleton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_shackleton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_shackleton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_shackleton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_shackleton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_shackleton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_shackleton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_shackleton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_shackleton } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_shackleton }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_shackleton = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_shackleton >= sr_site_slots_shackleton } value = sr_site_generic_pending_shackleton subtract = sr_site_slots_shackleton add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_peary } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_peary }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_peary } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_peary }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_peary } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_peary }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_peary } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_peary }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_peary } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_peary }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_peary } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_peary }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_peary = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_peary >= sr_site_slots_peary } value = sr_site_generic_pending_peary subtract = sr_site_slots_peary add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_peary = { value = sr_site_mine_value_peary multiply = sr_site_staffing_peary }
sr_site_yard_staffed_peary = { value = sr_site_yard_value_peary multiply = sr_site_staffing_peary }
sr_site_lab_staffed_peary = { value = sr_site_lab_value_peary multiply = sr_site_staffing_peary }
sr_site_culture_staffed_peary = { value = sr_site_culture_value_peary multiply = sr_site_staffing_peary }
sr_site_resort_staffed_peary = { value = sr_site_resort_value_peary multiply = sr_site_staffing_peary }
sr_site_black_staffed_peary = { value = sr_site_black_value_peary multiply = sr_site_staffing_peary }
sr_site_train_staffed_peary = { value = sr_site_train_value_peary multiply = sr_site_staffing_peary }
sr_site_bunker_staffed_peary = { value = sr_site_bunker_value_peary multiply = sr_site_staffing_peary }
sr_site_foundry_staffed_peary = { value = sr_site_foundry_value_peary multiply = sr_site_staffing_peary }
sr_site_admin_staffed_peary = { value = sr_site_admin_value_peary multiply = sr_site_staffing_peary }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).

	value = 10
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_peary multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }

}

	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_tranquility global_var:sr_site_spec_tranquility = 1 } value = 1 }

	value = sr_site_levels_tranquility
	add = sr_site_hab_value_tranquility
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_tranquility = {
	value = sr_site_levels_tranquility
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_tranquility = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_tranquility < sr_site_crew_needed_tranquility
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_tranquility ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_tranquility
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_tranquility
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_tranquility = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_tranquility
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_tranquility
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_tranquility
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_tranquility } multiply = 0 }
}

	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_tranquility
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_tranquility
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_tranquility
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_tranquility } multiply = 0 }
}

}
# Tranquility Base's slots: 2 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_tranquility = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_tranquility ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_tranquility ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_tranquility = { value = sr_site_slots_tranquility add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_tranquility } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_tranquility }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_train_marius_hills } value = global_var:sr_site_train_marius_hills }
}
sr_site_bunker_value_marius_hills = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_bunker_marius_hills } value = global_var:sr_site_bunker_marius_hills }
}

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_admin_marius_hills } value = global_var:sr_site_admin_marius_hills }
}
sr_site_port_value_marius_hills = { value = 0 }
sr_site_levels_marius_hills = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_marius_hills
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_marius_hills
	add = sr_site_def_value_marius_hills
	add = sr_site_mine_value_marius_hills
	add = sr_site_yard_value_marius_hills
	add = sr_site_lab_value_marius_hills
	add = sr_site_culture_value_marius_hills
	add = sr_site_resort_value_marius_hills
	add = sr_site_black_value_marius_hills
	add = sr_site_train_value_marius_hills
	add = sr_site_bunker_value_marius_hills
	add = sr_site_foundry_value_marius_hills
	add = sr_site_admin_value_marius_hills
}
sr_site_extra_levels_marius_hills = {
	value = sr_site_levels_marius_hills
	add = sr_site_hab_value_marius_hills
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_marius_hills = {
	value = sr_site_levels_marius_hills
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_marius_hills = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_marius_hills < sr_site_crew_needed_marius_hills
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_marius_hills ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_marius_hills
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_marius_hills
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_marius_hills = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_marius_hills
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_marius_hills
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_marius_hills
}
sr_site_mult_b_marius_hills = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_marius_hills
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_marius_hills
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_marius_hills
}

# Marius Hills's slots: 3 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_marius_hills = {
	value = 3
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_marius_hills ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_marius_hills ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_marius_hills = { value = sr_site_slots_marius_hills add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_marius_hills = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_marius_hills
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_marius_hills } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_marius_hills } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_marius_hills } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_marius_hills } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_marius_hills } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_marius_hills } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_marius_hills } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_marius_hills } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_marius_hills } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_marius_hills } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_marius_hills } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_marius_hills } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_marius_hills }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_marius_hills = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_marius_hills >= sr_site_slots_marius_hills } value = sr_site_generic_pending_marius_hills subtract = sr_site_slots_marius_hills add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_mine_staffed_marius_hills = { value = sr_site_mine_value_marius_hills multiply = sr_site_staffing_marius_hills }
sr_site_yard_staffed_marius_hills = { value = sr_site_yard_value_marius_hills multiply = sr_site_staffing_marius_hills }
sr_site_lab_staffed_marius_hills = { value = sr_site_lab_value_marius_hills multiply = sr_site_staffing_marius_hills }

sr_site_admin_staffed_marius_hills = { value = sr_site_admin_value_marius_hills multiply = sr_site_staffing_marius_hills }
# Its Extraplanetary Base room: the world's, and its Mining Complexes' (design § 7).
sr_site_ebase_room_marius_hills = {
	value = 25
	add = { value = sr_site_mine_staffed_marius_hills multiply = sr_mod_mine_room floor = yes }
}
sr_mod_spec_used_marius_hills = {
	value = sr_site_spec_built_marius_hills
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_marius_hills } add = var:sr_mq_a_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_marius_hills } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_marius_hills }

}
# The next module THIS queues at Marius Hills costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_marius_hills = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_marius_hills >= sr_site_slots_marius_hills } value = sr_mod_slots_used_marius_hills subtract = sr_site_slots_marius_hills add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

	value = 0

	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_daedalus global_var:sr_site_spec_daedalus = 1 } value = 1 }

	value = sr_site_levels_daedalus
	subtract = 1

sr_site_staffing_daedalus = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_daedalus < sr_site_crew_needed_daedalus
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_daedalus ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_daedalus
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_daedalus
	}
}

# Daedalus Crater's slots: 1 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_daedalus = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_daedalus ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_daedalus ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_daedalus = { value = sr_site_slots_daedalus add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_daedalus = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_daedalus
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_daedalus } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_daedalus }
}

# sr_module_points x (1 + n).

	value = sr_module_points

}

# The next module THIS queues at Daedalus Crater costs this (design § 5): past its slots,
# a hundred points more than the last.
sr_mod_next_cost_daedalus = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_mod_slots_used_daedalus >= sr_site_slots_daedalus } value = sr_mod_slots_used_daedalus subtract = sr_site_slots_daedalus add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}
sr_site_lvl_a_value_imbrium = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_imbrium } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_imbrium }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_imbrium global_var:sr_site_spec_imbrium = 1 } value = 1 }
}

	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_imbrium
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_imbrium
	add = sr_site_def_value_imbrium
	add = sr_site_mine_value_imbrium

	add = sr_site_foundry_value_imbrium
	add = sr_site_admin_value_imbrium

	value = sr_site_levels_imbrium
	add = sr_site_hab_value_imbrium
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_imbrium = {
	value = sr_site_levels_imbrium
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_imbrium = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_imbrium < sr_site_crew_needed_imbrium
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_imbrium ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_imbrium
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_imbrium
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_imbrium = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_imbrium
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_imbrium
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_imbrium
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_imbrium } multiply = 0 }
}

	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_imbrium
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_imbrium
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_imbrium
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_imbrium } multiply = 0 }
}

# Mare Imbrium's slots: 2 by its size, +1 with each of the holder's advanced_nanofabrication, molecular_assemblers; up to 4 modules past them.
sr_site_slots_imbrium = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_imbrium ?= { has_technology_researched = advanced_nanofabrication } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_imbrium ?= { has_technology_researched = molecular_assemblers } } add = 1 }
}
sr_site_slots_max_imbrium = { value = sr_site_slots_imbrium add = 4 }
# Its slots built or on their way, every shipper's: what the queue's head pays past.
sr_site_generic_pending_imbrium = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_imbrium
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_imbrium } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_imbrium }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_imbrium } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_imbrium }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_mine_imbrium } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_mine_imbrium }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_yard_imbrium } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_yard_imbrium }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_lab_imbrium } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_lab_imbrium }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_culture_imbrium } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_culture_imbrium }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_resort_imbrium } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_resort_imbrium }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_black_imbrium } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_black_imbrium }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_train_imbrium } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_train_imbrium }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_bunker_imbrium } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_bunker_imbrium }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_foundry_imbrium } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_foundry_imbrium }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_admin_imbrium } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_admin_imbrium }
}
# A slot module built for it now costs this: past its slots, the n-th past
# sr_module_points x (1 + n).
sr_mod_generic_cost_imbrium = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = { limit = { sr_site_generic_pending_imbrium >= sr_site_slots_imbrium } value = sr_site_generic_pending_imbrium subtract = sr_site_slots_imbrium add = 2 multiply = sr_module_points }
}

# The queue's head (sr_mq_1_site, sr_mq_1_type) costs this to build: a slot module
# (code 3 on) the world's sr_mod_generic_cost_<key>, a specialization level the base.
sr_mq_head_cost = {
	value = sr_module_points
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_1_site has_variable = sr_mq_1_type var:sr_mq_1_type >= 3 }
		if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 1 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_valles_marineris }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 2 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_olympus_mons }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 3 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_hellas_planitia }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 4 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_utopia_planitia }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 5 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_arcadia_planitia }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 6 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_ceres }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 7 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_vesta }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 8 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_psyche }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 9 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_pallas }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 10 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_hygiea }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 11 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_io }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 12 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_europa }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 13 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_ganymede }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 14 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_callisto }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 15 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_himalia }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 16 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_amalthea }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 17 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_venus }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sr_mq_1_site = 18 } value = sr_mod_generic_cost_mercury }

# Country scope: THIS's Extraplanetary Base room, in levels (design § 9): the
# near-Earth 10 with asteroid_mining (lunar colonization design § 6)
# and every colony it holds.

	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_valles_marineris } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris } } add = sr_site_ebase_room_valles_marineris }

	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_peary ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_peary } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_peary } } add = sr_site_ebase_room_peary }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_tranquility ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_tranquility } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_tranquility } } add = sr_site_ebase_room_tranquility }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_marius_hills ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_marius_hills } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_marius_hills } } add = sr_site_ebase_room_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_daedalus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_daedalus } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_daedalus } } add = sr_site_ebase_room_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_imbrium ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_imbrium } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_imbrium } } add = sr_site_ebase_room_imbrium }
}

# ===== Autonomy and free colonies (slice 5 design §§ 2-3) =====
# Per world, any scope: its autonomy (0 absent), the months since contact from
# Earth, the charter's share of its specializations, a free colony's suppliers.
# Holder scope: its autonomy's drift a month (the terms are
# sr_colony_autonomy_values.txt's). Country scope: THIS's ties with a free
# colony and its share of the colony's trade, in units.
sr_site_autonomy_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_autonomy_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_self_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_self_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_self_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_months_since_contact_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_valles_marineris } value = te_history_month_index subtract = global_var:sr_site_contact_valles_marineris }
	min = 0
}
# Every term but settling: where autonomy heads (colony management design § 4.2).
sr_site_aut_pressure_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_aut_home_pull
	add = { value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris divide = 10000 multiply = sr_aut_per_10k_people }
	add = { value = sr_transit_months_mars multiply = sr_aut_per_transit_month max = sr_aut_distance_cap }
	if = { limit = { sr_site_months_since_contact_valles_marineris > sr_aut_no_contact_months } add = sr_aut_no_contact }
	if = { limit = { is_at_war = yes } add = sr_aut_at_war }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_valles_marineris } add = sr_aut_garrisoned }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_valles_marineris } add = sr_aut_chartered }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_destroyed_colony_until var:sr_destroyed_colony_until > te_history_month_index } add = sr_aut_destroyed_colony }
	add = { value = sr_site_admin_staffed_valles_marineris multiply = sr_aut_per_admin_level }
}
# The month's drift: the pressure less settling, a share of the autonomy itself, so
# autonomy settles at the pressure / sr_aut_settle_rate (design § 4.2).
sr_site_aut_drift_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_aut_pressure_valles_marineris
	subtract = { value = sr_site_autonomy_value_valles_marineris multiply = sr_aut_settle_rate }
}
# The points a month it builds its own modules with (design § 4.3).
sr_site_self_rate_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_autonomy_value_valles_marineris
	divide = 100
	multiply = { value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris divide = 10000 }
	multiply = sr_aut_selfbuild_per_10k
	max = sr_aut_selfbuild_max
}
sr_site_charter_factor_valles_marineris = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_valles_marineris } value = sr_aut_charter_share }
}
sr_site_suppliers_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_suppliers_valles_marineris }
}
sr_free_ties_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_valles_marineris } value = var:sr_free_ties_valles_marineris }
}
sr_free_trade_share_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris has_global_variable = sr_site_free_valles_marineris }
		value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
		divide = sr_free_trade_people_per_unit
		divide = { value = sr_site_suppliers_value_valles_marineris min = 1 }
	}
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_vesta } add = sr_aut_garrisoned }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_vesta } add = sr_aut_chartered }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_destroyed_colony_until var:sr_destroyed_colony_until > te_history_month_index } add = sr_aut_destroyed_colony }
	add = { value = sr_site_admin_staffed_vesta multiply = sr_aut_per_admin_level }
}
# The month's drift: the pressure less settling, a share of the autonomy itself, so
# autonomy settles at the pressure / sr_aut_settle_rate (design § 4.2).
sr_site_aut_drift_vesta = {
	value = sr_site_aut_pressure_vesta
	subtract = { value = sr_site_autonomy_value_vesta multiply = sr_aut_settle_rate }
}
# The points a month it builds its own modules with (design § 4.3).
sr_site_self_rate_vesta = {
	value = sr_site_autonomy_value_vesta
	divide = 100
	multiply = { value = sr_site_pop_value_vesta divide = 10000 }
	multiply = sr_aut_selfbuild_per_10k
	max = sr_aut_selfbuild_max
}
sr_site_charter_factor_vesta = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_vesta } value = sr_aut_charter_share }
}
sr_site_suppliers_value_vesta = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_vesta } value = global_var:sr_site_suppliers_vesta }

sr_free_ties_value_vesta = {

		value = sr_site_pop_value_vesta
		divide = sr_free_trade_people_per_unit
		divide = { value = sr_site_suppliers_value_vesta min = 1 }
	}

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_callisto } value = var:sr_free_ties_callisto }
}
sr_free_trade_share_callisto = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_callisto has_global_variable = sr_site_free_callisto }
		value = sr_site_pop_value_callisto
		divide = sr_free_trade_people_per_unit
		divide = { value = sr_site_suppliers_value_callisto min = 1 }
	}
}
sr_site_autonomy_value_himalia = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_himalia } value = global_var:sr_site_autonomy_himalia }
}
sr_site_self_value_himalia = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_self_himalia } value = global_var:sr_site_self_himalia }
}
sr_site_months_since_contact_himalia = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_himalia } value = te_history_month_index subtract = global_var:sr_site_contact_himalia }
	min = 0
}
# Every term but settling: where autonomy heads (colony management design § 4.2).
sr_site_aut_pressure_himalia = {
	value = sr_aut_home_pull
	add = { value = sr_site_pop_value_himalia divide = 10000 multiply = sr_aut_per_10k_people }
	add = { value = sr_transit_months_jupiter multiply = sr_aut_per_transit_month max = sr_aut_distance_cap }
	if = { limit = { sr_site_months_since_contact_himalia > sr_aut_no_contact_months } add = sr_aut_no_contact }
	if = { limit = { is_at_war = yes } add = sr_aut_at_war }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_himalia } add = sr_aut_garrisoned }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_himalia } add = sr_aut_chartered }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_destroyed_colony_until var:sr_destroyed_colony_until > te_history_month_index } add = sr_aut_destroyed_colony }
	add = { value = sr_site_admin_staffed_himalia multiply = sr_aut_per_admin_level }
}
# The month's drift: the pressure less settling, a share of the autonomy itself, so
# autonomy settles at the pressure / sr_aut_settle_rate (design § 4.2).
sr_site_aut_drift_himalia = {
	value = sr_site_aut_pressure_himalia
	subtract = { value = sr_site_autonomy_value_himalia multiply = sr_aut_settle_rate }
}
# The points a month it builds its own modules with (design § 4.3).
sr_site_self_rate_himalia = {
	value = sr_site_autonomy_value_himalia
	divide = 100
	multiply = { value = sr_site_pop_value_himalia divide = 10000 }
	multiply = sr_aut_selfbuild_per_10k
	max = sr_aut_selfbuild_max
}
sr_site_charter_factor_himalia = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_himalia } value = sr_aut_charter_share }
}
sr_site_suppliers_value_himalia = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_himalia } value = global_var:sr_site_suppliers_himalia }
}
sr_free_ties_value_himalia = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_himalia } value = var:sr_free_ties_himalia }

	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_himalia has_global_variable = sr_site_free_himalia }
		value = sr_site_pop_value_himalia
		divide = sr_free_trade_people_per_unit
		divide = { value = sr_site_suppliers_value_himalia min = 1 }
	}

}
# Every term but settling: where autonomy heads (colony management design § 4.2).
sr_site_aut_pressure_mimas = {
	value = sr_aut_home_pull
	add = { value = sr_site_pop_value_mimas divide = 10000 multiply = sr_aut_per_10k_people }
	add = { value = sr_transit_months_saturn multiply = sr_aut_per_transit_month max = sr_aut_distance_cap }
	if = { limit = { sr_site_months_since_contact_mimas > sr_aut_no_contact_months } add = sr_aut_no_contact }
	if = { limit = { is_at_war = yes } add = sr_aut_at_war }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_mimas } add = sr_aut_garrisoned }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_mimas } add = sr_aut_chartered }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_destroyed_colony_until var:sr_destroyed_colony_until > te_history_month_index } add = sr_aut_destroyed_colony }
	add = { value = sr_site_admin_staffed_mimas multiply = sr_aut_per_admin_level }
}
# The month's drift: the pressure less settling, a share of the autonomy itself, so
# autonomy settles at the pressure / sr_aut_settle_rate (design § 4.2).
sr_site_aut_drift_mimas = {
	value = sr_site_aut_pressure_mimas
	subtract = { value = sr_site_autonomy_value_mimas multiply = sr_aut_settle_rate }
}
# The points a month it builds its own modules with (design § 4.3).
sr_site_self_rate_mimas = {
	value = sr_site_autonomy_value_mimas
	divide = 100
	multiply = { value = sr_site_pop_value_mimas divide = 10000 }
	multiply = sr_aut_selfbuild_per_10k
	max = sr_aut_selfbuild_max
}
sr_site_charter_factor_mimas = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_mimas } value = sr_aut_charter_share }
}
sr_site_suppliers_value_mimas = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_mimas } value = global_var:sr_site_suppliers_mimas }
}
sr_free_ties_value_mimas = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_mimas } value = var:sr_free_ties_mimas }
}
sr_free_trade_share_mimas = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_mimas has_global_variable = sr_site_free_mimas }
		value = sr_site_pop_value_mimas
		divide = sr_free_trade_people_per_unit
		divide = { value = sr_site_suppliers_value_mimas min = 1 }
	}
}

# The points a month it builds its own modules with (design § 4.3).
sr_site_self_rate_proteus = {
	value = sr_site_autonomy_value_proteus
	divide = 100
	multiply = { value = sr_site_pop_value_proteus divide = 10000 }
	multiply = sr_aut_selfbuild_per_10k
	max = sr_aut_selfbuild_max
}
sr_site_charter_factor_proteus = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_proteus } value = sr_aut_charter_share }
}
sr_site_suppliers_value_proteus = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_proteus } value = global_var:sr_site_suppliers_proteus }
}
sr_free_ties_value_proteus = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_proteus } value = var:sr_free_ties_proteus }
}

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_proteus has_global_variable = sr_site_free_proteus }
		value = sr_site_pop_value_proteus
		divide = sr_free_trade_people_per_unit
		divide = { value = sr_site_suppliers_value_proteus min = 1 }
	}

	min = 0

# Every term but settling: where autonomy heads (colony management design § 4.2).
sr_site_aut_pressure_pluto = {
	value = sr_aut_home_pull
	add = { value = sr_site_pop_value_pluto divide = 10000 multiply = sr_aut_per_10k_people }
	add = { value = sr_transit_months_kuiper multiply = sr_aut_per_transit_month max = sr_aut_distance_cap }
	if = { limit = { sr_site_months_since_contact_pluto > sr_aut_no_contact_months } add = sr_aut_no_contact }
	if = { limit = { is_at_war = yes } add = sr_aut_at_war }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_pluto } add = sr_aut_garrisoned }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_pluto } add = sr_aut_chartered }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_destroyed_colony_until var:sr_destroyed_colony_until > te_history_month_index } add = sr_aut_destroyed_colony }
	add = { value = sr_site_admin_staffed_pluto multiply = sr_aut_per_admin_level }
}
# The month's drift: the pressure less settling, a share of the autonomy itself, so
# autonomy settles at the pressure / sr_aut_settle_rate (design § 4.2).

	value = sr_site_aut_pressure_pluto
	subtract = { value = sr_site_autonomy_value_pluto multiply = sr_aut_settle_rate }

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_tranquility } value = global_var:sr_site_autonomy_tranquility }
}
sr_site_self_value_tranquility = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_self_tranquility } value = global_var:sr_site_self_tranquility }
}
sr_site_months_since_contact_tranquility = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_tranquility } value = te_history_month_index subtract = global_var:sr_site_contact_tranquility }
	min = 0
}
# Every term but settling: where autonomy heads (colony management design § 4.2).
sr_site_aut_pressure_tranquility = {
	value = sr_aut_home_pull
	add = { value = sr_site_pop_value_tranquility divide = 10000 multiply = sr_aut_per_10k_people }
	add = { value = sr_transit_months_moon multiply = sr_aut_per_transit_month max = sr_aut_distance_cap }
	if = { limit = { sr_site_months_since_contact_tranquility > sr_aut_no_contact_months } add = sr_aut_no_contact }
	if = { limit = { is_at_war = yes } add = sr_aut_at_war }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_tranquility } add = sr_aut_garrisoned }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_tranquility } add = sr_aut_chartered }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_destroyed_colony_until var:sr_destroyed_colony_until > te_history_month_index } add = sr_aut_destroyed_colony }
	add = { value = sr_site_admin_staffed_tranquility multiply = sr_aut_per_admin_level }
}
# The month's drift: the pressure less settling, a share of the autonomy itself, so
# autonomy settles at the pressure / sr_aut_settle_rate (design § 4.2).
sr_site_aut_drift_tranquility = {
	value = sr_site_aut_pressure_tranquility
	subtract = { value = sr_site_autonomy_value_tranquility multiply = sr_aut_settle_rate }
}
# The points a month it builds its own modules with (design § 4.3).
sr_site_self_rate_tranquility = {
	value = sr_site_autonomy_value_tranquility
	divide = 100
	multiply = { value = sr_site_pop_value_tranquility divide = 10000 }
	multiply = sr_aut_selfbuild_per_10k
	max = sr_aut_selfbuild_max
}
sr_site_charter_factor_tranquility = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_tranquility } value = sr_aut_charter_share }
}
sr_site_suppliers_value_tranquility = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_tranquility } value = global_var:sr_site_suppliers_tranquility }
}
sr_free_ties_value_tranquility = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_tranquility } value = var:sr_free_ties_tranquility }
}
sr_free_trade_share_tranquility = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_tranquility has_global_variable = sr_site_free_tranquility }
		value = sr_site_pop_value_tranquility
		divide = sr_free_trade_people_per_unit
		divide = { value = sr_site_suppliers_value_tranquility min = 1 }
	}
}

	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_titania } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_oberon } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_miranda } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_ariel } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_triton } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_proteus ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_proteus } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_pluto } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_eris ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_eris } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_makemake } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_haumea } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_sedna } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_shackleton ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_shackleton } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_peary ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_peary } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_tranquility ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_tranquility } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_marius_hills ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_marius_hills } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_daedalus ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_daedalus } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_imbrium ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_imbrium } add = 1 }
}

# ===== Fleets: defences, integrity, marines, occupation (slice 6 design §§ 7-10) =====
# Per world, any scope:
#   sr_site_marines_value_<key>    battalions standing there (the holder's; the
#                                  occupier's while occupied)
#   sr_site_integrity_value_<key>  0-100, 100 while unset
#   sr_site_militia_value_<key>    a battalion a sr_militia_people, at least one
#   sr_site_garrison_need_<key>    the marines a seizure must exceed: garrison and militia
#   sr_site_def_fire_<key>         its Defences' fire on fleets closing in: 15 a level x
#                                  1.5 (+25% Orbital Weapon Platforms, its holder's) x
#                                  integrity; nothing while occupied
#   sr_site_hardness_<key>         50 + 50 a Defences level
#   sr_site_target_strength_<key>  what draws a closing-in fleet's defence fire from
#                                  stationed hostiles: its Defences and its hull
#   sr_site_ws_weight_<key>        its weight in war support, 0.1 to 0.25 by its people
sr_site_marines_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_marines_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_marines_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_integrity_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_integrity_full
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_integrity_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_integrity_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_militia_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	divide = sr_militia_people
	floor = yes
	min = 1
}
# A seizure must exceed the garrison and the militia; a liberation, the
# occupier's garrison alone (its people are the holder's).
sr_site_garrison_need_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_marines_value_valles_marineris
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris } } add = sr_site_militia_value_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_def_fire_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris } sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris > 0 }
		value = sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris
		multiply = sr_def_strength_per_level
		multiply = sr_def_fire_factor
		if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { has_technology_researched = orbital_weapon_platforms } } multiply = 1.25 }
		multiply = { value = sr_site_integrity_value_valles_marineris divide = sr_integrity_full }
	}
}
sr_site_hardness_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_def_hardness_per_level
	add = sr_def_hardness_base
}
sr_site_target_strength_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_def_strength_per_level
	add = sr_def_hull_strength
}
sr_site_ws_weight_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	divide = sr_ws_colony_full_people
	max = 1
	multiply = sr_ws_colony_growth
	add = sr_ws_colony_base
}

	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_hygiea } } add = sr_site_militia_value_hygiea }
}
sr_site_def_fire_hygiea = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_hygiea } sr_site_def_value_hygiea > 0 }
		value = sr_site_def_value_hygiea
		multiply = sr_def_strength_per_level
		multiply = sr_def_fire_factor
		if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= { has_technology_researched = orbital_weapon_platforms } } multiply = 1.25 }
		multiply = { value = sr_site_integrity_value_hygiea divide = sr_integrity_full }
	}
}
sr_site_hardness_hygiea = {
	value = sr_site_def_value_hygiea
	multiply = sr_def_hardness_per_level
	add = sr_def_hardness_base
}
sr_site_target_strength_hygiea = {
	value = sr_site_def_value_hygiea
	multiply = sr_def_strength_per_level
	add = sr_def_hull_strength
}
sr_site_ws_weight_hygiea = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_hygiea
	divide = sr_ws_colony_full_people
	max = 1
	multiply = sr_ws_colony_growth
	add = sr_ws_colony_base
}
sr_site_marines_value_io = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_marines_io } value = global_var:sr_site_marines_io }
}
sr_site_integrity_value_io = {
	value = sr_integrity_full
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_integrity_io } value = global_var:sr_site_integrity_io }
}
sr_site_militia_value_io = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_io
	divide = sr_militia_people
	floor = yes
	min = 1
}
# A seizure must exceed the garrison and the militia; a liberation, the
# occupier's garrison alone (its people are the holder's).
sr_site_garrison_need_io = {
	value = sr_site_marines_value_io
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_io } } add = sr_site_militia_value_io }
}
sr_site_def_fire_io = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_io } sr_site_def_value_io > 0 }
		value = sr_site_def_value_io
		multiply = sr_def_strength_per_level
		multiply = sr_def_fire_factor
		if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= { has_technology_researched = orbital_weapon_platforms } } multiply = 1.25 }
		multiply = { value = sr_site_integrity_value_io divide = sr_integrity_full }
	}
}
sr_site_hardness_io = {
	value = sr_site_def_value_io
	multiply = sr_def_hardness_per_level
	add = sr_def_hardness_base
}
sr_site_target_strength_io = {
	value = sr_site_def_value_io
	multiply = sr_def_strength_per_level
	add = sr_def_hull_strength
}
sr_site_ws_weight_io = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_io
	divide = sr_ws_colony_full_people
	max = 1
	multiply = sr_ws_colony_growth
	add = sr_ws_colony_base

# Country scope: war support from occupied colonies (design § 10), a beat: each
# world THIS occupies from a holder it is at war with, less each of its own an
# enemy occupies. The fleets' month stores it (sr_ws_colonies_net), so the
# injection reads one variable.
sr_ws_colonies_sum = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_olympus_mons ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_olympus_mons ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_hellas_planitia ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_hellas_planitia ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_utopia_planitia ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_utopia_planitia ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_arcadia_planitia ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_arcadia_planitia ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_ceres ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_ceres }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_ceres ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_ceres }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_vesta ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_vesta }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_vesta ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_vesta }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_psyche ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_psyche }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_psyche ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_psyche }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_pallas ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_pallas }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_pallas ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_pallas }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_hygiea ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_hygiea ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_io ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_io }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_io ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_io }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_europa ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_europa }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_europa ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_europa }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_ganymede ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_ganymede ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_callisto ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_callisto }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_callisto ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_callisto }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_himalia ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_himalia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_himalia ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_himalia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_amalthea ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_amalthea ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_amalthea ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_amalthea ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_venus ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_venus }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_venus ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_venus }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_mercury ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_mercury }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_mercury ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_mercury }

# ===== Destinations in reach (colony management design § 6) =====
# Country scope, per destination: 1 with a world THIS may target there
# (sr_cf_targetable_<key>) within its drive's horizon (sr_cf_horizon_months),
# 2 with one beyond it, 0 with none.
sr_window_reach_moon = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { sr_cf_targetable_shackleton = yes sr_cf_targetable_peary = yes sr_cf_targetable_tranquility = yes sr_cf_targetable_marius_hills = yes sr_cf_targetable_daedalus = yes sr_cf_targetable_imbrium = yes } }
		value = 2
		if = { limit = { sr_transit_months_moon <= sr_cf_horizon_months } value = 1 }
	}
}
sr_window_reach_mars = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes sr_cf_targetable_olympus_mons = yes sr_cf_targetable_hellas_planitia = yes sr_cf_targetable_utopia_planitia = yes sr_cf_targetable_arcadia_planitia = yes } }
		value = 2
		if = { limit = { sr_transit_months_mars <= sr_cf_horizon_months } value = 1 }
	}
}
